segments.vv65:1.3: Tathūpamaṃ tuyhamidaṃ vimānaṃ, obhāsayaṃ tiṭṭhati antalikkhe.
segments.vv65:2.3: Kenāsi evaṃ jalitānubhāvo, vaṇṇo ca te sabbadisā pabhāsatī”ti.
segments.vv65:3.3: Pañhaṃ puṭṭho viyākāsi, yassa kammassidaṃ phalaṃ.
segments.vv65:4.3: Annañca pānañca pasannacittā, sakkacca dānaṃ vipulaṃ adamha.
segments.vv65:5.1: “Tena metādiso vaṇṇo … pe … vaṇṇo ca me sabbadisā pabhāsatī”ti.
